stem.text: A cell is shown in the micrograph.

stem.alt: Electron micrograph of a cell with a large nucleus, many membrane-bound folded structures and several rounded organelles.

stem.text: Which statement explains how it is possible to identify the type of microscope used to produce the micrograph?

A.text: The nucleus is visible, so an electron microscope was used.

B.text: The endoplasmic reticulum is **not** visible, so a light microscope was used.

C.text: Chloroplasts are visible, so a light microscope was used.

D.text: Ribosomes are visible, so an electron microscope was used.
